newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Escorts in venture with Mahle.
newsitem.headline: India's Escorts in venture with Mahle.

text.p: Indian automotive firm Escorts Ltd said on Thursday it had launched a joint venture with Germany's Mahle GmbH, as an equal partner.
"The joint venture company, Escorts Mahle Ltd, will manufacture automotive and railway pistons and gudgeon pins," Escorts said in a statement.
"The new company will take over the existing manufacturing facilities of Escorts Ltd in Bangalore and Patiala," the statement added.
It will also bring within its fold the pistons business of Goetze (India) Limited, an Escorts group company, it said.
The statement gave no further details and did not explain whether the facilities would be sold, or hived off in some other manner.
Escorts said it has had a technical collaboration with Mahle, a leader in piston technology, since 1959.
